findings.title: The public git history still holds the name of the reference product and the code of a former project (reference/, 12 files, 160799 bytes); rewriting was left to the owner in decision 0019 and not asked again when the repository was opened
findings.where: git history: commits 7591fc0 (adds reference/ and run sources, 2026-10-05) and 187b0aa (removes them from the tree, 2026-10-06); the name is also in handoffs/PROD-20261006-02/step-05-req-validator.json and handoffs/REQ-20261006-01/step-01-req-analyst.json (commits 6143f0c, 3cb5166, 956decd, a879495); decisions/0019-standalone-no-traces.md section 'Граница'; decisions/0111-repository-open-on-purpose.md
findings.evidence: git log --all -i -S'<name of the reference product>' --format=%h -> 6 commits (7591fc0 187b0aa 6143f0c 3cb5166 956decd a879495). git ls-tree -r -l 7591fc0 -- reference -> 12 files, 160799 bytes (a former project, with a C# domain file whose comment names the reference product). git branch -r --contains 7591fc0 -> origin/main, origin/m0-records. gh repo view --json visibility -> PUBLIC. decisions/0019 'Граница': «Старые коммиты git содержат прежние названия и код reference/. Переписывать историю git ORCH не стал: ... нужно отдельное решение владельца»; grep of decisions/0111 for '0019', 'reference/' and 'history' -> the decision does not treat the history. No open defect in docs/issues/ covers it. The working tree is clean (0 hits in 2970 files; traces: 0 traces).
findings.item: decision 0082 item 3 and decision 0019 (no Q item is broken: no secret involved)
findings.recommendation: Ask the owner (a question for ORCH, not a file edit): either accept in a new decision that the history stays public with the names and the former project's code (and say who owns that code), or rewrite the history (git filter-repo over reference/, runs/WF06-2026092*/sources and the two handoffs, then a forced push and a new clone everywhere, plus a request to GitHub to drop cached views), or make the repository private again (decision 0111). Until the owner decides, record the open risk in STATE.md and decisions/0111.

findings.title: GitHub secret scanning is disabled on a repository that has been public since 2026-11-15
findings.evidence: gh api repos/<owner>/sai/secret-scanning/alerts -> {"message":"Secret scanning is disabled on this repository.","status":"404"}; gh repo view --json visibility -> "PUBLIC".
findings.recommendation: The owner turns on 'Secret scanning' and 'Push protection' in the repository settings (free for public repositories); the project's own findsecrets stays the first line. Not a defect in any document, so Low.

summary.text: No real secret, key, personal number, computer path or user name in the documents of the part, in the working tree or in the history of the documents; the traces check gives 0 traces in 2903 files and the name of the reference product is in no file of the tree. One High: the public git history still carries that name and the code of a former project (decision 0019 left the rewriting to the owner and the opening of the repository did not ask again). Two Low: the Vercel team and project ids stand in a public line although the runbooks already use placeholders ('not secret' is right for credentials, not for harmless), and GitHub secret scanning is off.
